name: Days to Expiry
description: Returns the number of calendar days remaining until the given instrument's expiry.

parameters.name: Underlying
parameters.description: Underlying symbol, e.g. 'NIFTY 50'. Used in condition builder, e.g. Days to Expiry(NIFTY 50) < Number(7).

note: No official Tradetron docs/OCR capture existed for this keyword in the source scrape; schema derived from its real usage in tests/known_good/good_iron_fly.json ('Days to Expiry(NIFTY 50) < Number(7)').
